dz: 蒙塔古男爵手下的约克主义军队在玫瑰会之战中击败了萨默塞特公爵手下的一支兰卡斯特里亚军队赫德利摩尔之战.

dz: 在受到罗马公民的虐待和毁容后,教宗利奥三世逃到帕德伯恩的查理曼国王的法兰克人宫去保护.
de: After mistreatment and disfigurement by the citizens of Rome, Pope Leo III flees to the Frankish court of king Charlemagne at Paderborn for protection.

te: The Battle of Bagrevand puts an end to an Armenian rebellion against the Abbasid Caliphate. Muslim control over the Sou…
dz: 巴格雷万德战役结束了亚美尼亚人对阿巴斯德·哈里发的叛乱. 穆斯林对南高加索的控制得到巩固并开始伊斯兰化,而几个主要的亚美尼亚纳哈拉尔家族丧失了权力,他们的残余逃到拜占庭帝国.
de: The Battle of Bagrevand puts an end to an Armenian rebellion against the Abbasid Caliphate. Muslim control over the South Caucasus is solidified and its Islamization begins, while several major Armenian nakharar families lose power and their remnants flee to the Byzantine Empire.

de: Admiral Lysander and King Pausanias of Sparta blockade Athens and bring the Peloponnesian War to a successful conclusion.
